summary: Verified root-cause fix for 'Dispositivi Vitali' bug on client 86BIT_Office (da3d6e40-b3e5-4d46-9787-dde328a3aa36). connector-master devices (source='connector-master', id prefix 'poll_') were previously dropped by DeviceResponse validation (missing created_at) causing is_vital to be lost. Post-fix: GET /api/devices now returns 'created_at' on connector-loop devices and preserves is_vital. End-to-end UI + API confirmed working.

GET /api/devices then returned is_vital=true for BOTH devices including connector-master 'poll_192_168_1_254' (Zyxel USG Test firewall). Previously this returned is_vital=null — bug is FIXED.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix confirmed. connector-master devices (id prefix 'poll_') now correctly carry is_vital across GET /api/devices. Only 1 connector-master device in this preview DB (192.168.1.254 Zyxel USG Test firewall). Bulk-vital endpoint uses {ips: [...], is_vital: bool, client_id: str} not device_ids. Reset endpoint is POST /api/clients/{client_id}/devices/reset-vital.
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: In routes/devices.py get_devices connector-merge loop, device dicts constructed for connector-master sources were missing the 'created_at' field which is REQUIRED by DeviceResponse Pydantic model (models.py line 105). This caused DeviceResponse(**d) to raise ValidationError. The except fallback then rebuilt the response without preserving is_vital / is_vital_set_at fields, so connector-master devices that had been marked vital via bulk-vital appeared as is_vital=null in GET /api/devices, hence the frontend counter devices.filter(d=>d.is_vital===true).length stayed at 0. FIX: (1) Added created_at to the connector-loop dict (~line 462); (2) except fallback now preserves is_vital and is_vital_set_at and logs the ValidationError. VERIFIED: 192.168.1.254 (poll_192_168_1_254) now returns with created_at set and is_vital=true after bulk-mark, and renders in the Vitali tab.
